backend-services/tests/test_logging_perm.notes: A role transitions from no log permission to view-only to view-and-export; all reader, export, and download endpoints assert the corresponding HTTP permission contracts and LOG codes.

backend-services/tests/test_memory_dump_.notes: A real memory-mode gateway receives SIGUSR1, writes an encrypted dump to the current configured directory, and restores its API data after a restart.
The Unix process lifecycle test sends SIGUSR1 to the running gateway and asserts the handler's completion log plus persisted snapshot behavior.
An encrypted binary dump is read back exactly; a real storage snapshot is restored after mutation, while wrong-key and tampered byte sequences are rejected atomically.

backend-services/tests/test_rate_limiter.notes: The quota usage status reports the Python-compatible remaining amount and no warning below 80% usage.
The quota status enters warning at 80% usage without entering critical status.
The quota status enters critical status at 95% usage.
A quota at its limit is exhausted, disallowed, and reports zero remaining.
The rate limiter allows the first request in a configured window and preserves the user-scoped counter contract.
A prior-window count weighted into the new window causes the configured sliding-window limit to return HTTP 429 policy failure.
The request policy invokes a configured token bucket and permits its base capacity plus explicit burst allowance.
The request policy rejects the request immediately after all configured base and burst tokens are consumed.
The policy admits a spike within the explicit burst allowance.
Half a configured two-second window refills one token, which the policy then admits.
